tokoh_utama: A 25-year-old Indonesian male office worker with short messy black hair, wearing a navy blue button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, work ID card on a red lanyard around his neck, carrying a leather backpack and holding a smartphone.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau tombol 13 nyala sendiri, kamu turun di lantai 12 atau ikut naik?
part.caption: Jangan sekali-kali pencet tombol lift yang muncul di tengah malam...

adegan.narasi: Apartemen tempat tinggalku sama sekali tidak memiliki lantai 13.
adegan.gambar: Apartment lobby elevator area late at night, quiet dimly lit interior with elevator door.

adegan.narasi: Tapi setiap jam 12 malam tepat, tombol angka 13 mendadak muncul.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of modern metallic elevator wall panel showing button numbers 1 to 12.

adegan.narasi: Pak satpam cuma tertawa santai saat kutanya, "Itu paling cuma stiker iseng."
adegan.gambar: Friendly middle-aged security guard in uniform laughing near apartment reception desk.

adegan.narasi: Malam ini aku pulang lembur dari kantor sekitar jam 12 lewat sedikit.
adegan.gambar: Male worker walking along quiet outdoor corridor of apartment building late at night.

adegan.narasi: Lobi apartemen sangat sepi, aku melangkah masuk sambil sibuk mengetik pesan ponsel.
adegan.gambar: Male worker standing in empty apartment elevator hallway looking down typing on smartphone.

adegan.narasi: Pintu lift stainless steel terbuka lebar, meniupkan udara dingin yang sangat aneh.
adegan.gambar: Stainless steel elevator doors opening wide into bright interior, cold mist swirling out.

adegan.narasi: Aku masuk ke dalam lift sendirian dan langsung menekan tombol lantai 12.
adegan.gambar: Inside elevator, male worker pressing button 12. In the reflective stainless steel wall, a shadowy identical male duplicate is visible standing right behind him.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba tombol angka 13 di papan lift menyala merah redup sendiri.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of elevator button panel, button 13 glowing dim red automatically.

adegan.narasi: Aku panik menekan tombol batal berulang kali, tapi tombol itu tetap menyala.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of male worker's hand frantically tapping cancel button on glowing elevator panel.

adegan.narasi: Lift bergerak naik melampaui lantai 12 tanpa menunjukkan tanda-tanda akan berhenti.
adegan.gambar: Digital floor indicator inside elevator passing number 12 and continuing upward movement.

adegan.narasi: Dentang lift berbunyi nyaring ketika indikator angka di atas pintu menunjukkan 13.
adegan.gambar: Digital floor indicator above elevator door shining brightly with red number 13.

adegan.narasi: Pintu terbuka perlahan, menampilkan lorong gelap dengan semua pintu nomor 1313.
adegan.gambar: Elevator doors opening to reveal pitch black creepy apartment hallway with door numbers all reading 1313.

part.pertanyaan: Menurut kalian, siapa yang sekarang tinggal di unitku?
part.caption: Ternyata aku tidak sendirian di lantai 13...

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan... Lorong lantai 13 itu terasa sangat kaku dan berbau tanah basah.
adegan.gambar: Dark narrow apartment hallway on 13th floor, peeling yellowed wallpaper and damp ceiling stains.

adegan.narasi: Aku segera keluar dari lift untuk mencari pintu tangga darurat terdekat.
adegan.gambar: Male worker stepping out of elevator cautiously into dark eerie corridor looking around.

adegan.narasi: Gagang pintu tangga darurat ternyata terkunci rapat dan tidak bisa digerakkan.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of male worker trying to turn heavy rusty emergency staircase door handle.

adegan.narasi: Dari ujung lorong yang remang, aku melihat sesosok penghuni berdiri diam.
adegan.gambar: Dim hallway view showing a tall shadowy figure standing motionless at the far dark end.

adegan.narasi: Orang itu berdiri sangat kaku sambil menempelkan dahi dan wajahnya ke tembok.
adegan.gambar: Creepy male resident standing unnaturally stiff, face pressed completely flat against hallway wall.

adegan.narasi: Aku mendekat perlahan dan bertanya gemetar, "Permisi, tangga darurat sebelah mana ya?"
adegan.gambar: Male worker approaching creepy resident facing wall. On the wall, the resident's shadow shows abnormally long thin fingers clutching the wallpaper.

adegan.narasi: Tanpa menoleh sedikit pun, suara beratnya berbisik kaku dari balik tembok.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of back of creepy resident's pale neck and disheveled dark hair pressed against wall.

adegan.narasi: Pria itu berbisik pelan, "Jangan naik lift lagi. Aku sudah tujuh tahun di sini."
adegan.gambar: Side angle of creepy resident's face pressed to wall, mouth barely moving, pale skin.

adegan.narasi: Bulu kudukku berdiri seketika, udara di sekitar terasa makin membeku dan mencekam.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of male worker's face pale with utter terror and eyes wide in panic.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba dentang lift di belakangku berbunyi nyaring memecah kesunyian lorong.
adegan.gambar: Elevator door behind male worker glowing with bright chime indicator light turning on.

adegan.narasi: Pintu lift terbuka lebar perlahan-lahan secara otomatis tanpa ada yang memanggil.
adegan.gambar: Elevator doors opening slowly, bright overhead interior light flooding dark hallway.

adegan.narasi: Di dalam lift berdiri diriku sendiri yang sedang menunduk sibuk main HP.
adegan.gambar: Inside elevator stands an exact duplicate of the male worker wearing navy shirt, red lanyard, looking down at smartphone.

part.pertanyaan: Menurutmu, gimana cara membedakan aku yang asli dengan yang palsu?
part.caption: Jangan pernah masuk lift bareng aku kalau aku nggak menyapa...

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan... Aku melotot tak percaya melihat kembaranku berdiri santai di dalam lift.
adegan.gambar: Male worker staring in complete disbelief at duplicate clone standing inside open elevator.

adegan.narasi: Tanpa berpikir panjang, aku langsung berlari kencang berusaha menerobos masuk lift.
adegan.gambar: Male worker sprinting desperately towards open elevator door with outstretched arm.

adegan.narasi: Namun kembaranku perlahan menengadah perlahan, menatap mataku dengan tatapan kosong.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of clone inside elevator raising head slowly, revealing pitch black hollow eyes.

adegan.narasi: Dia menekan tombol tutup pintu sambil mengukir senyuman yang sangat lebar.
adegan.gambar: Clone inside elevator smiling unnaturally wide while pressing door close button on elevator panel.

adegan.narasi: Pintu lift tertutup rapat persis di depan mukaku sebelum aku sempat menyentuhnya.
adegan.gambar: Elevator doors slamming shut right in front of male worker's outstretched hand.

adegan.narasi: Lampu lorong lantai 13 mendadak padam satu per satu, menyisakanku dalam kegelapan.
adegan.gambar: Corridor ceiling lights shutting off sequentially, plunging male worker into terrifying dark.

adegan.narasi: Pagi harinya, tetangga lantai 12 melihatku keluar dari lift seperti biasa.
adegan.gambar: CCTV camera perspective of elevator door opening on bright floor 12 in morning light. In dark crack above open elevator door, a pale creepy clawed hand is clinging inside.

adegan.narasi: Tetanggaku menyapa ramah, "Pagi Mas, kok tumben mukanya pucat banget begitu?"
adegan.gambar: Friendly middle-aged male neighbor smiling and greeting fake male worker in sunlit hallway.

adegan.narasi: Kembaranku tidak menjawab sedikit pun dan terus melangkah kaku menunduk main HP.
adegan.gambar: Fake male worker walking stiffly past neighbor without looking up from smartphone.

adegan.narasi: Sosok asliku sebenarnya masih terjebak di lorong 1313 untuk selamanya.
adegan.gambar: Real male worker sitting curled up on damp dark floor of hallway 1313 in pitch blackness.

adegan.narasi: Kalau kalian ketemu aku di lift lantai 12 dan aku nggak menyapa...
adegan.gambar: Close-up profile of fake male worker inside elevator, cold emotionless eyes.

adegan.narasi: Jangan pernah masuk ke dalam lift itu bareng aku.
adegan.gambar: Elevator doors closing slowly, darkness engulfing the cold unblinking face of the clone.
